footnote_text: The reported transaction involves the reporting person's receipt of a grant of 250,000 restricted stock units ("RSUs") under Golden Minerals Company's Amended and Restated 2023 Equity Incentive Plan. Each RSU represents a contingent right to receive one share of the Issuer's common stock. The RSUs are scheduled to vest in two equal tranches on October 1, 2027 and October 1, 2028.
